submit_form.description: Fired when a user submits a loan application form, capturing the completion status and page context.

loanApplication.description: Object containing loan application submission data, including the status of the application completion.

select_content.description: Fired when a user selects or views financial product content, capturing page context, user language and returning status, and privacy category consent.

page.description: Object containing page metadata including destination URL, geography, language, page identification, and financial product category context.

user.description: Object containing user profile attributes including preferred language and visit frequency status.

privacy.description: Object containing privacy and cookie consent category declarations with domain-level tracking classifications.
